title: Private rooms: choose shopkeepers after everyone has joined
problem: In a private room each person picks a shopkeeper before joining and can change it in the lobby while others are still joining; the owner wants the choice made once everyone is in.
scope: No shopkeeper choice before joining or in the lobby of a private room
After the host taps Start the game: a step where every person chooses a shopkeeper at once (taken ones greyed, first come), then confirms; the computers take the rest and the match begins
Server: a picking status between lobby and playing; joining refused while picking; a seat gone past the grace period gets a free shopkeeper
Protocol version bumped so older phones are asked to update
exclusions: Any rule, number or save change (rules version stays 19)
